items.name: Glowcap
items.text: A small pale mushroom that glows blue-green in the dark. It grows where the ground stays wet.

items.name: Fir resin
items.text: Amber sap from the old firs, hard on the outside and sticky inside. It burns slow and bright.

items.name: Scrap metal
items.text: Rusted metal from cars and cabins nobody came back for. Still good for patching things.

items.name: Copper wire
items.text: Copper wire from where the old power line came down. Sometimes it still hums.

items.name: Cloth scraps
items.text: Strips of curtain and blanket from rooms nobody lives in anymore. Still dry.

items.name: Anomaly shard
items.text: A sliver of something like glass, warm even in the cold. It gives off a light of its own.

items.name: Thermos
items.text: Hot coffee someone left by the fire for whoever comes next. Drink it to get some energy back.
